name: mantaprint-hub
changelog: PROTOTYPE RELEASE: MantaPrint is published as a prototype. It is not hardened for production, sensitive data or regulated environments. Read SECURITY.md and docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md before installing.
New home: github.com/mantaplex/mantaprint-prototype. All updater and documentation links point to the new repository.
Installer now shows a prototype risk notice and requires explicit acceptance before changing the system; acceptance is recorded in /etc/mantaprint/prototype-ack.json.
Every web app (Hub, Scan Studio, Scanner PWA, MantaPool, console), the TUI and /api/version are labelled as Prototype.
